rules: All enemy types visibly move backward before sequence start
Every combo followup uses a shorter rearward reset after prior return, without adding gameplay delay
One presentation owner writes enemy X/Y, no independent tween
HomeX-relative motion, groundedY, original danger bounds and dodge windows unchanged
Current attack > prior return > next windup priority

Ordinary hits do not cancel the enemy queue: show white flash/reaction without resetting windup/attack/return. Cancel motion and queue only when Core cancels for stun/death; no residual dash or duplicate damage
Player slash approach and effect endpoint follow retreating enemy; retreat grants no invulnerability
Audio off/reduced shake retains retreat, shape and timing cue
enemyRhythm.activePoseBinding: Always bind pose and retreat to closest unresolved Impact, not the most recently revealed future direction cue. Cue order can preview future hits while active timing stays on current hit.
